item.name: Revenant's Brooch

effects.title: Phantom Critical
effects.text: Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal an additional 80% of the attack's damage as bonus magic damage.

notes: Counts as a Critical Strike for purposes of stacking with other sources of Critical Strike.
Phantom Critical does not work against buildings.
item.lore: The cursed brooch of a fallen guardian who stalks forever between the veil of life and death.
